subject: Take the transpose of a row_vector

messages.author: 17d1c8192f4bc4be
messages.subject: Take the transpose of a row_vector
parts:
Hi all,

Here it goes again another version of the model I ask for help on in few recents posts. Thanks for your suggestions, I have been able to speed up the code. I know have as a second model the following code ( see below). The mean of the multi_normal is vector type (not row_vector). So I would like to transpose my row_vector into vector. However, Stan gives me the following error. I am not sure what I am missing here. I suspect it maybe something very simple or not. Thanks very much for your help.

Error: unexpected string constant in:
"
lambd[j] ~ multi_normal( mu_lb[j]'"
Execution halted



cat("########################## Stan code *********\n")
Bcca_modcomp <- '
data {
int<lower=1> N; 
int<lower=1> n1;
int<lower=1> n2;
int<lower=1> d;
int<lower=1> m; 
int X[N,n1];
int Y[N,n2];
matrix[m,n1] phi_a; 
matrix[m,n2] phi_b; 
}
parameters{
real<lower=0> bet[d];
real<lower=0> sig_te;
real<lower=0> sig_lb;
matrix[N,d] Z;
matrix[d,m] A; 
matrix[d,m] B; 
matrix[N,m] teta;
matrix[N,m] lambd;
row_vector[m] mux;
row_vector[m] muy;
}
transformed parameters {
matrix[N,n1] mu_te;
matrix[N,n2] mu_lb;
row_vector[n1] mn_te;
row_vector[n2] mn_lb;
cov_matrix[n1] Sig_te;
cov_matrix[n2] Sig_lb; 
real<lower=0> beta_sqt[d];
real<lower=0> siglb_sr;
real<lower=0> sigte_sr;
mu_te <- Z*A*phi_a;
mu_lb <- Z*B*phi_b;
siglb_sr <- sqrt(sig_lb);
sigte_sr <- sqrt(sig_te);
mn_te <- mux*phi_a;
mn_lb <- muy*phi_b;
Sig_te <- crossprod(phi_a) + diag_matrix(rep_vector(sig_te, cols(phi_a)));
Sig_lb <- crossprod(phi_b) + diag_matrix(rep_vector(sig_te, cols(phi_b)));
for(i in 1:d)
beta_sqt[i] <- sqrt(bet[i]);
}

model{

for(i in 1:m)
{
mux[i] ~ normal(0, 1000);
muy[i] ~ normal(0, 1000);
}

bet ~ gamma(2, 1);
sig_lb ~ scaled_inv_chi_square(10, .1);
sig_te ~ scaled_inv_chi_square(10, .1);

for(i in 1:d)
{
A[i] ~ normal(0, beta_sqt[i]);
B[i] ~ normal(0, beta_sqt[i]);
}

for(j in 1:N)
{
Z[j] ~normal(0, 1);
teta[j] ~ multi_normal( mu_te[j]' + mn_te', Sig_te);
X[j] ~ poisson_log(teta[j]);

lambd[j] ~ multi_normal( mu_lb[j]' + mn_lb', Sig_lb); 
Y[j] ~ poisson_log(lambd[j]);
}
}
'
cat("Stan code done .... \n")

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Take the transpose of a row_vector
parts:
Could you tell us more about which versions of RStan and compilers
and R you're using?

I get this error for your model:

Model name=maxwell_model
Input file=/Users/carp/temp2/maxwell.stan
Output file=/Users/carp/temp2/maxwell.cpp

EXPECTATION FAILURE LOCATION: file=/Users/carp/temp2/maxwell.stan; line=67, column=59

^-- here


DIAGNOSTIC(S) FROM PARSER:
no matches for function name="multi_normal_log"
arg 0 type=row vector
arg 1 type=vector
arg 2 type=matrix
available function signatures for multi_normal_log:
0. multi_normal_log(vector, vector, matrix) : real
unknown distribution=multi_normal
Parser expecting: <eps>

And the required fix is to transpose the variable teta[j] and lambd[j]
so they conform to the type signature for multi_normal_log:

X[j] ~ poisson_log(teta[j]);

lambd[j]' ~ multi_normal( mu_lb[j]' + mn_lb', Sig_lb);
Y[j] ~ poisson_log(lambd[j]);
}

I've attached a working version (let's see if the mailing list
lets the .stan file through -- if not, I'll repost).

We already have adding more signatures to multi_normal on our
to-do list because other users have struggled with this issue, too.
There's no reason multi_normal can't be defined to work for
row vectors as well as vectors in the first two argument slots
(variate and location parameter).

A better solution to coding the model than transposing is to just
reorganize the rows and columns of mu_te and mu_lb and to define
mn_te and mn_lb as vectors rather than row-vectors. Even more efficient
is an array of vectors for mu_te and mu_lb. There's a new chapter
in the manual explaining (or at least trying to) the difference between
arrays, vectors, row vectors, and matrices.

- Bob
